title: Choose the visual world for Bagel's Sitter Guide (cute and pink)
question: Re-roll with your steer: everything here is cute and pink. The roll assigned the Kawaii Sticker Sheet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Kawaii Sticker Sheet
options.lineage: kawaii stationery: memo pads and die-cut sticker sheets
options.thesis: Each step is a page of a cute memo pad; finishing it peels a sticker off Bagel's sticker sheet, and the emptying sheet is your progress.
materials: die-cut vinyl stickers with white keyline
options.viewport: Pink header with Bagel's face sticker and the sticker sheet (14 cute icons, 3 already used); the door note pinned at top; the current memo page with photo, poster-size quantity and a big 'Stick it! Done' button; the next pages peeking below.
options.risk: Could get twee if every surface gets stickers; stickers are reserved for done-state and progress only.

raised.raise: One rounded face (M PLUS Rounded 1c, which also sets 功能 / 取消) carries display and caption alike; rank by size and weight only.
State lives in one fixed slot per step: an empty sticker outline until done, the sticker once done, never anywhere else.
Everything sits on an 8px grid and reflows in whole cells; no free-floating decoration.
The visit splits into two named halves (Arrive and feed / Tidy, play and leave) with a hard break between them.
Quantities are set as true fractions in tabular figures (⅓ can, ½ pump) at poster size, never spelled out.

options.label: Virtual Pet Care Meters
options.thesis: The visit is literally a virtual pet's care routine: feed, water, clean, play. Bagel's care meters fill as each step is done.
options.viewport: A pink header with four care meters (Food, Water, Litter, Play) and Bagel's face; below, the current step card with photo and quantity, and a big Done button that tops up its meter.
options.risk: Meters could be misread as Bagel's real health; they track the sitter's tasks only and say so.

options.label: Focus Card Wall
options.thesis: Steps as photo tiles; the current one grows and reveals its details while the rest dim, translated into raspberry and candy pink.
options.viewport: Rows of step photos grouped by phase; the current step's tile is expanded with its quantity and Done button; done tiles shrink and dim.
options.case: Holds clarity (the focused step is unmissable and photos lead) but loses identification: it reads as a streaming app, not Bagel's cute guide.
options.risk: Dark ground fights the pinned cute, light pink feel by day.

options.label: Design Annual Plates
options.thesis: Photos as registered plates on near-white stock with a signed stamp.
options.viewport: A continuous sheet of photo plates with hairline credits.
options.case: Austere and gallery-like; cannot carry cute or pink without losing itself.
options.kept: One typeface carries display and caption alike.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.thesis: Raked glass slides set at one single type size.
options.viewport: A lateral rack of slanted slides.
options.case: One type size cannot put the quantity at poster scale, and raked panes slow reading.
options.kept: State is a mark in one fixed cell.

options.label: Grid Type Specimen
options.thesis: Letterforms built cell by cell on a visible grid.
options.viewport: Huge grid-built numerals over a visible armature.
options.case: Rigid modernism; neither cute nor about the task.

options.label: Mixtape J-card
options.thesis: The visit as side A and side B tracklists in ballpoint.
options.viewport: A folded inlay with two tracklists.
options.case: Needs running times we don't have, and ballpoint blue is not the pinned pink.
options.kept: Two hard halves with a clear break.

options.label: Darkroom Exposure Record
options.thesis: Translucent sheets with hatch densities and stop deltas.
options.case: Technical and grey; the opposite of cute.
options.kept: Quantities set as true fractions in tabular figures.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean phone checklist app in a soft pink theme: grouped list, checkmarks, thumbnails.
canonCard.viewport: A progress header, the door warning as a banner, then grouped steps with tick circles and thumbnails.
canonCard.risk: Tidy but generic; the cuteness is only a colour.
